title: The Wilshire | New Lux Villa Mins to Old Town
description:
Airlume Stays presents: The Wilshire - a refined villa curated for the ultimate luxury experience. Host all of your favorite people: True 7 bedrooms/5 bathrooms with a total of 11 pillow-top Beautyrest beds, just minutes away from Old Town Scottsdale, Chase Field, Spring Training and PHX. 

A bespoke wellbeing journey awaits: late mornings nestled up in luxury linens, sunsets in our heated pool and cool nights relaxing in the hot tub. Come relax and reconnect in this Sonoran-inspired manor.
amenities: 75 inch HDTV with Apple TV, standard cable, Amazon Prime Video
Clothing storage: walk-in closet, closet, and dresser
Private hot tub - available seasonally, open 24 hours
Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, heated, pool toys
review_snippets: This home is in the top 10% of eligible listings based on ratings, reviews, and reliability

Amazing place to stay, 10/10 would recommend. Pictures on the website don’t do the house enough justice. Was perfect for a 10 person bachelor party, and only like 10 minutes from “old town”. Phenomenal experience.

This place was stunning and we had a wonderful stay! The hosts were amazing, incredibly attentive, and always quick to respond whenever we had a question. Their communication made everything so easy, and we really appreciated how supportive they were throughout our stay. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it!
We had an amazing time at this property! The host was amazing and responsive and the place was perfect for our large group. Check in and check out were made so easy! Would definitely recommend!

Our stay was great! We had a group of 16 and the house and amenities fit everyone well and comfortably. The pool was wonderful and the outdoor amenities were great! A lot of space for big groups! Host was very responsive.

Everything was perfect. Clean bathrooms, comfy beds and pillows with clean bedding. A washer and dryer were available and the host also provided laundry detergent and dryer sheets. There was a steamer and an iron- super handy while traveling. They accommodated our very large party and were very flexible. There were pool towels and also some pool floats. Kitchen was very clean. Everything you would need for a kitchen were provided. 10/10 stay. House was beautiful and hosts were welcoming.

My group stayed here for a golf trip and it was such a great decision. The host was very accommodating and friendly. The house was beautiful with great amenities including the pool, hot tub, the outdoor TV area and the putting green. The location was phenomenal; close to the airport, the downtown area and the courses we played (We Ko Pa and Papago). In all, very happy with our group’s decision to stay here.
